generationContext.text:
# Microsoft Azure Elastic SAN management client library for .NET

Microsoft Azure Elastic SAN is a cloud-native service that offers a scalable, cost-effective, high-performance, and comprehensive storage solution for a range of compute options. Get the same simplified management experience in the cloud as with your on-premises storage area network (SAN). Gain higher resiliency and minimize downtime with rapid provisioning.

This library supports managing Microsoft Azure Elastic SAN resources.

This library follows the [new Azure SDK guidelines](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/general_introduction.html), and provides many core capabilities:

    - Support MSAL.NET, Azure.Identity is out of box for supporting MSAL.NET.
    - Support [OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/) for distributed tracing.
    - HTTP pipeline with custom policies.
    - Better error-handling.
    - Support uniform telemetry across all languages.

## Getting started 

### Install the package

Install the Microsoft Azure Elastic SAN management library for .NET with [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/):

```dotnetcli
dotnet add package Azure.ResourceManager.ElasticSan
```

### Prerequisites

* You must have an [Microsoft Azure subscription](https://azure.microsoft.com/free/dotnet/).

### Authenticate the Client

To create an authenticated client and start interacting with Microsoft Azure resources, see the [quickstart guide here](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/doc/dev/mgmt_quickstart.md).

## Key concepts

Key concepts of the Microsoft Azure SDK for .NET can be found [here](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/dotnet_introduction.html).

## Documentation

Documentation is available to help you learn how to use this package:

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/doc/dev/mgmt_quickstart.md).
- [API References](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/?view=azure-dotnet).
- [Authentication](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/sdk/identity/Azure.Identity/README.md).

## Examples

Code samples for using the management library for .NET can be found in the following locations
- [.NET Management Library Code Samples](https://aka.ms/azuresdk-net-mgmt-samples)

## Troubleshooting

-   File an issue via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/issues).
-   Check [previous questions](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/azure+.net) or ask new ones on Stack Overflow using Azure and .NET tags.

## Next steps

For more information about Microsoft Azure SDK, see [this website](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/).

## Contributing

For details on contributing to this repository, see the [contributing
guide][cg].

This project welcomes contributions and suggestions. Most contributions
require you to agree to a Contributor License Agreement (CLA) declaring
that you have the right to, and actually do, grant us the rights to use
your contribution. For details, visit <https://cla.microsoft.com>.

When you submit a pull request, a CLA-bot will automatically determine
whether you need to provide a CLA and decorate the PR appropriately
(for example, label, comment). Follow the instructions provided by the
bot. You'll only need to do this action once across all repositories
using our CLA.

This project has adopted the [Microsoft Open Source Code of Conduct][coc]. For
more information, see the [Code of Conduct FAQ][coc_faq] or contact
<opencode@microsoft.com> with any other questions or comments.

proposals.subtype: Hidden volume-group factory supplies an extra default option
proposals.explanation: Adds a hidden volume-group model factory overload forwarding its supplied arguments to another overload with enforceDataIntegrityCheckForIscsi explicitly default.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The forwarding factory is explicitly implemented in src/Customize outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Hidden factory converts nullable capacities to defaulted values
proposals.explanation: Adds a hidden ElasticSanData factory accepting nullable baseSizeTiB and extendedCapacitySizeTiB, calls GetValueOrDefault on both and forwards the remaining arguments to another overload.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The nullable-capacity adapter is handwritten in Customize/ArmElasticSanModelFactory.cs.

proposals.subtype: Volume factory builds nested properties with an empty manager list
proposals.explanation: Adds a volume model factory constructing VolumeProperties from the supplied data and size, initializes its manager collection with a new ChangeTrackingList<ElasticSanManagedByInfo>, and passes it into a new ElasticSanVolumeData.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The full model-construction body is supplied in the Customize factory rather than generated source.

proposals.subtype: Patch factory conditionally constructs nested update properties
proposals.explanation: Adds a size-only volume-patch factory that passes default nested properties for null sizeGiB, otherwise constructs VolumeUpdateProperties with the size and a new empty change-tracking manager list.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The conditional nested-model construction is explicitly implemented in Customize/ArmElasticSanModelFactory.cs.

proposals.subtype: Hidden volume factories translate a single manager identifier
proposals.explanation: Adds two hidden volume-data factories differing in parameter order; each calls the core factory and, when managedByResourceId is non-null, appends a manager entry created with a single-element resourceIds array through AddManagedBy.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both compatibility overloads and their shared list-adaptation helper are handwritten in the Customize factory.

proposals.subtype: Hidden patch factory translates a single manager identifier
proposals.explanation: Adds a hidden volume-patch factory taking sizeGiB and managedByResourceId, delegates to the size-only factory and uses AddManagedBy to append a single manager entry only when the identifier is non-null.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The overload and the shared adaptation helper are explicitly supplied in the Customize factory.

proposals.subtype: SAN factory assembles nested properties and collection defaults
proposals.explanation: Adds the non-nullable-capacity ElasticSanData factory, defaults null tags to a change-tracking dictionary, materializes availability zones and private endpoints with ToList after null fallbacks, wraps scaleUpProperties in AutoScaleProperties and constructs nested ElasticSanProperties and ElasticSanData.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The explicit construction and defaulting body is supplied in Customize/ArmElasticSanModelFactory.cs outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Snapshot constructor accepts a creation-info model
proposals.explanation: Adds a public SnapshotCreationInfo constructor that explicitly rejects null and initializes Properties with a new SnapshotProperties using the creation model and default values for the remaining supplied slots.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The constructor body is provided in a Customize model partial outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Flattened snapshot source identifier lazily constructs properties
proposals.explanation: Adds CreationDataSourceId returning default when Properties is null; its setter requires a non-null value and constructs SnapshotProperties only when Properties is absent, otherwise assigning the existing nested member without that local guard.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both branches of this flattened accessor are explicitly implemented in Customize/ElasticSanSnapshotData.cs.

proposals.subtype: Hidden single-manager alias replaces the manager collection
proposals.explanation: Adds a hidden ManagedByResourceId alias returning an identifier only for exactly one manager entry with exactly one resource ID; setting it first clears ManagedBy and then adds a new single-ID entry only for a non-null value.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The list-to-scalar getter and destructive replacement setter are supplied in Customize/ElasticSanVolumeData.cs.

proposals.subtype: Hidden retention-policy accessor lazily creates group properties
proposals.explanation: Adds a hidden DeleteRetentionPolicy property returning default for absent Properties; its setter creates a new VolumeGroupProperties when needed and assigns the supplied policy, including null.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The getter and lazy-initializing setter are handwritten in Customize/ElasticSanVolumeGroupData.cs.

proposals.subtype: Hidden patch single-manager alias replaces the manager collection
proposals.explanation: Adds a hidden ManagedByResourceId accessor on the patch model that returns an ID only for a singleton manager containing a singleton resource-ID list; setting it clears the collection and optionally inserts one new single-ID manager.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This separate patch-model accessor is explicitly implemented in Customize/ElasticSanVolumePatch.cs.

proposals.subtype: Resource constructor configures two REST clients and API fallback
proposals.explanation: Supplies an internal ArmClient/resource-ID constructor that delegates to the base, resolves the resource API version, initializes diagnostics plus Volumes and ElasticSanClient REST clients with the shared pipeline/endpoint and a 2026-05-01-preview null fallback, then calls ValidateResourceId.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The constructor body and additional REST-client fields are explicitly supplied in a Customize resource partial outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Hidden delete overloads convert legacy arguments to strings
proposals.explanation: Adds hidden sync and async Delete overloads taking nullable XmsDeleteSnapshot and XmsForceDelete arguments, calls ToString on each, supplies null for the next argument and forwards waitUntil and cancellationToken to another overload.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The explicit argument-conversion adapters are handwritten in Customize/ElasticSanVolumeResource.cs.

proposals.subtype: Hidden delete overloads default the added delete-type argument
proposals.explanation: Adds hidden sync and async Delete overloads accepting nullable ElasticSanDeleteSnapshotsUnderVolume and ElasticSanForceDeleteVolume values and forwarding them unchanged to another overload with deleteType explicitly null.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The compatibility overloads are explicitly supplied in the Customize resource partial rather than Generated.

proposals.subtype: Restore wrappers construct a location-finalized typed operation
proposals.explanation: Implements hidden sync and async RestoreVolume methods that build a cancellation-bearing RequestContext, create and send a restore request using resource-ID components, construct ElasticSanArmOperation<ElasticSanVolumeResource> with OperationFinalStateVia.Location and a typed operation source, and wait only for WaitUntil.Completed; diagnostic failures are marked and rethrown.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The initial request orchestration, operation construction and conditional completion calls are explicitly implemented in Customize/ElasticSanVolumeResource.cs.

proposals.subtype: Hidden extensible string enum with consistent ignore-case equality
proposals.explanation: Defines a hidden readonly string-backed struct with a null-rejecting constructor, true/false named values, implicit string conversion, equality operators and invariant-culture ignore-case equality and hashing; ToString returns the stored string.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The full value-type implementation is supplied in Customize/Models outside Generated.

decisions.reason: The non-generated Customize factory explicitly defines a hidden volume-group factory overload and forwards to another overload with the additional iSCSI integrity flag set to default at lines 31-35. This is a handwritten model-factory API shape; generation of such a forwarding overload is plausible.

Lines 40-44 explicitly define the hidden nullable-capacity factory and convert both nullable capacities using GetValueOrDefault before forwarding. The handwritten factory overload and model-override category are supported; compatibility is suggested by the source comment but is not required as an established causal fact.

Lines 63-79 implement this non-generated model factory, construct nested VolumeProperties with an empty ChangeTrackingList of managers, and construct ElasticSanVolumeData. This is a factory-model construction instance, not a claim about a generated factory's behavior.

The handwritten size-only factory at lines 89-92 passes default nested properties for null sizeGiB and otherwise constructs VolumeUpdateProperties with an empty manager list. The cited range contains the complete conditional behavior.

The two hidden handwritten factory signatures at lines 108-114 and 128-134 differ in parameter order but perform the same manager-ID adaptation; the helper at lines 148-154 appends a single-ID entry only for a non-null identifier. Counting the shared behavior once is appropriate.

Lines 140-154 define a distinct hidden patch-model factory overload and its shared helper; the overload builds a patch and conditionally adds a single-ID manager. Its affected model differs from the volume-data factory.

The non-generated factory at lines 178-209 constructs nested SAN properties, supplies a tag dictionary when absent, materializes zone and endpoint lists, and wraps scale-up properties. These are parts of one factory-construction behavior with a complete cited body.

The Customize partial's public constructor at lines 18-23 validates creationData and initializes SnapshotProperties. The cited source directly supports an alternative model constructor; it does not establish why the constructor was needed.

The handwritten accessor at lines 26-40 projects a nested source ID, returns default when Properties is null, initializes Properties on first non-null assignment, and otherwise assigns to the existing nested member. The proposal correctly distinguishes the null guard's two branches.

Lines 19-37 define a hidden scalar model-property alias: the getter returns a value only for a singleton manager with one ID, while the setter clears the collection and adds a replacement only for a non-null ID. The Customize partial and cited lines support the claimed instance.

The Customize partial at lines 15-26 defines the hidden retention-policy accessor, returns default without Properties, creates VolumeGroupProperties when needed, and assigns the supplied value. This is a model-property addition with a lazy nested-property bridge.

The separate patch model's Customize partial at lines 18-36 implements the singleton-ID getter and destructive collection-replacement setter. Its symbol and cited file are distinct from the volume-data property despite sharing the reusable alias pattern.

Lines 26-40 support a handwritten internal resource constructor wiring diagnostics and two REST clients with an API-version fallback, but do not show a changed public client constructor signature. The catalog's client-constructor-signature pattern denotes a different shape; the generator's ability to supply this particular multi-client wiring is not established by the capture.

finding.subtype: Resource constructor initializes REST clients with an API-version fallback
finding.explanation: An internal volume-resource constructor initializes diagnostics and two REST clients using the resource pipeline and endpoint, falls back to 2026-05-01-preview when no API version is returned, and validates the resource ID.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The internal constructor and its REST-client initialization are implemented in src/Customize/ElasticSanVolumeResource.cs outside src/Generated/.

decisions.reason: The hidden handwritten sync and async delete overloads at lines 67-69 and 96-98 call ToString on each nullable legacy parameter and forward to another overload with an added null argument. The source supports the adapter behavior, not a claim that null values are preserved as null strings.

Lines 125-127 and 154-156 explicitly implement hidden handwritten async and sync overloads that forward the typed arguments and default deleteType to null. The overload pair represents one compatibility behavior.

The Customize partial does handwrite sync and async restore request/typed-operation wrappers at the cited lines. It constructs an existing ElasticSanArmOperation and waits conditionally; the supplied evidence does not show a custom poller implementation or altered polling strategy. The LRO operation-wrapper catalog pattern better describes the observed reusable shape.

finding.subtype: Handwritten sync and async restore LRO wrappers
finding.explanation: The restore methods construct and send a request using the volume resource ID, wrap its response in a typed ElasticSanArmOperation with a Location final state, wait when requested, and report exceptions to their diagnostic scopes.
finding.handwrittenRationale: Both restore method bodies and operation construction are implemented in src/Customize/ElasticSanVolumeResource.cs outside src/Generated/; no custom poller internals are shown.

decisions.reason: Lines 12-48 explicitly implement the non-generated string-backed value type, including named values, string conversion, case-insensitive equality and matching hash behavior. The catalog's extensible-string-enum pattern matches this reusable model-override shape.
